rng_policy: Independent instance RNG, same seed 42; one run per task. No claim of server determinism.
concurrency_policy: Task-local selection metadata fixes concurrent window provenance; frozen batch concurrency 4 in every arm.
budget_policy: 60 rollout iterations per arm; actual calls/input/output tokens reported, not claimed equal-token.
critical_ledger: Retained in all arms; only its revisit scheduling is ablated online.
probe_schedule: Retain original Full outer probe gate and critical-revisit inner gate in all applicable arms.

analyses.common_selector: mean-risk top-k, k=min(n,max(4,ceil(0.45*n))); native output reported separately
analyses.selector_size_matching: Match each Full trace endpoint actual k; locked admission capacity frozen to that endpoint k before replay.
analyses.prefix_interpretation: Observed-evidence completion prefixes, not independent shorter-budget reruns.
analyses.selector_root_at_3: Shared mean-risk ranking within a trace; not selector-specific improvement.
analyses.failure_denominator: All 80 cases per model/arm for hit metrics; scientific failure scores zero. Pending or infrastructure failure keeps formal rates incomplete; report observed-hit lower bounds and failure type. Compression on valid outputs.
analyses.independence_unit: 20 source SCCs; injected variants, prefixes and selector outputs are not independent new samples.
analyses.reporting: All completed arms and predetermined settings retained; no quality-based rerun or result exclusion.

historical_main_results: Preserved; new Full belongs only to this contemporaneous ablation.
recovery_policy: Resume completed tasks without rerunning. Do not resample scientific failures or unknown outcomes.
authorization: User requested all proposed experiments, one run only, previous concurrency, existing cluster allocation.
